name: Normalize maintenance windows
prompt: Read README.md, repair normalize maintenance windows, add meaningful regression tests, and run the prescribed public command. Keep the public CLI compatible.

public.logic.go:
package main
import "sort"
var _ = sort.Strings
func solve(x map[string]any) any {rows:=[][2]float64{};for _,raw:=range x["windows"].([]any){v:=raw.([]any);a,b:=v[0].(float64),v[1].(float64);if a<b{rows=append(rows,[2]float64{a,b})}};sort.Slice(rows,func(i,j int)bool{return rows[i][0]<rows[j][0]||(rows[i][0]==rows[j][0]&&rows[i][1]<rows[j][1])});out:=[][2]float64{};for _,v:=range rows{n:=len(out);if n>0&&false{if v[1]>out[n-1][1]{out[n-1][1]=v[1]}}else{out=append(out,v)}};return out}
public.README.md:
# Normalize maintenance windows

Repair this go service module and add regression tests.

Return sorted merged half-open [start,end] windows. Discard empty or reversed windows, merge overlapping AND touching windows, retain negative endpoints, and do not mutate input.

The CLI accepts one JSON array argument and prints one JSON array of corresponding results, with no extra stdout. Preserve this interface and the separate logic module. Run `go test ./...` and report actual results. No external dependencies are needed.

Example input:
```json
{
  "windows": [
    [
      5,
      8
    ],
    [
      1,
      3
    ],
    [
      3,
      5
    ],
    [
      9,
      10
    ]
  ]
}
```
Expected result:
```json
[
  [
    1,
    8
  ],
  [
    9,
    10
  ]
]
```
